music.name: An Evening with podcast host & co-creator Phoebe Judge
music.why: A live, in-person podcast-format storytelling event recorded with audience interaction
music.summary: Phoebe Judge brings Criminal Presents: Don't Worry to the stage as a live, in-person edition of the podcast — a podcast-style evening of storytelling and conversation recorded before an audience.

music.name: Gettin Knit
music.why: A relaxed, social Monday: bring a project or learn one from friendly regulars, from 5pm until whenever.
music.summary: A weekly Monday-night knit and crochet circle at The Lone Star Saloon, with a DJ bartender. Beginners welcome.

music.name: “Motown On Mondays” DJ Night (Madrone Art Bar)
music.why: A dedicated Motown DJ format that blends originals with exclusive remixes and guest DJ sets.
music.summary: Hosts DJ Gordo Cabeza and rotating guest DJs spin Motown originals, exclusive remixes and close relatives of classic Motown tunes, keeping a dance‑floor–focused soul/R&B vibe.

music.name: So HOUSE Your Evening So Far?
music.why: A free, no-cover house party every Monday, with a different DJ lineup and a friendly community crowd.
music.summary: Weekly Monday house night at The Valencia Room in the Mission, with free entry all night and a free RSVP guest list. Five DJs on the bill, hosted by Blends & Trends.

music.name: Willi Carlisle
music.why: A rowdy, literate folk night from one of the genre's best live performers, in a 500-capacity room.
music.summary: Willi Carlisle brings his folk songs, storytelling and fiddle-and-accordion barn-burners to The Independent. All ages; doors 7:30 PM.

music.name: Karaoke Tuesday at Neck of the Woods
music.why: A recurring neighborhood karaoke night that focuses on pop, rock and indie tracks.
music.summary: A weekly karaoke sing-along where locals take the mic to perform pop, rock and indie favorites.

music.name: Labiahead - California Tour 2026
music.why: A night of Radiohead songs played live in a 500-capacity room, for fans who want the catalog without an arena.
music.summary: Labiahead, a Radiohead tribute act, plays The Independent on its California tour, with Charlene Kaye, Lena Hall and Meg Toohey on the bill.

music.name: The Moth SF StorySLAM: SECOND CHANCES
music.why: Theme-focused, audience-voted storytelling that puts personal true tales head-to-head.
music.summary: A live StorySLAM where participants tell true, personal stories responding to the theme “Second Chances” in a short, competitive format judged by the audience.

music.name: Ruby Haunt
music.why: A hypnotic, intimate take on dream-pop that emphasizes DIY, widescreen arrangements.
music.summary: Los Angeles duo Ruby Haunt deliver melancholic dream-pop and autumnal slowcore, built around hushed vocals, expressive guitars and slow-burning, widescreen arrangements. Their steadfast DIY approach gives the songs an intimate, hypnotic feel.

music.name: Syd
music.why: Smooth, intimate neo-soul from Syd in a historic single-screen movie palace, a good midweek night out.
music.summary: Syd, the Internet frontwoman and R&B solo artist, plays The Castro Theatre on the Beard Tour. All ages.

music.name: The Velvet Teen, Shutups, Pocket Full of Crumbs
music.why: Preview the bands' tracks online ahead of the show.
music.summary: A three-band bill headlined by The Velvet Teen with support from Shutups and Pocket Full of Crumbs; Sounds Like Tonight offers previews of the lineup online.

music.name: Xlov
music.why: An immersive performance-first set that prioritizes communal connection between artist and audience.
music.summary: An electrifying live show blending music and performance, focused on connection as stage and crowd come together.

music.name: Kim Petras: De-Tour w/Cece Natalie
music.why: A pop headliner in a club-sized room — a rare close-up chance to catch Kim Petras in a warehouse venue.
music.summary: Kim Petras brings her De-Tour tour to The Midway for a Wednesday night of glossy dance-pop, with Cece Natalie as special guest.

music.name: Labiahead - California Tour 2026 - 2 Nights!
music.why: A two-night stop on a California tour, giving fans two chances to catch the act live.

music.name: Pokey LaFarge
music.why: A sharp, charismatic live band in one of SF's most atmospheric old-school rooms.
music.summary: Pokey LaFarge brings his vintage-flavored blend of roots, swing and Americana to Bimbo's 365 Club, with Cicada Rhythm in support. 21+.

music.name: Sugar Candy Mountain, The Breathing Room, Marika Christine
music.why: A warm, hazy midweek rock show in one of SF's best small clubs.
music.summary: Psychedelic-pop duo Sugar Candy Mountain headline Bottom Of The Hill with The Breathing Room and Marika Christine. 21+.

music.name: Yung Gravy
music.why: Meme-rap showman with a loud, tongue-in-cheek live set, in one of SF's most storied rooms.
music.summary: Yung Gravy brings his Joyrider Tour to The Fillmore for a general-admission standing show, with Terror Reid in support. Doors are around 7 PM.

music.name: 4th Annual Bat Show 2026: Nocturnal Emissions & Holiday Havoc (111 Minna)
music.why: Reinterpretations of Winston Smith’s iconic bat emblem presented alongside a live BATNAP! performance.
music.summary: A gallery exhibition presented by Winston Smith’s Studio Fallout and Alternative Tentacles that gathers paintings, collage, sculpture and other three-dimensional takes on Smith’s iconic bat emblem, celebrating punk’s DIY spirit. The night also features a live set from Olympia darkwave/post-punk duo BATNAP! with synthesizers, guitars and drum machines.

music.name: Crazy Karaoke: SF’s Wild New Thursday Night Party + $3 Shots (SF)
music.why: Huge 1000+ song selection plus a recurring “Crazy Hour” $3 shot special keeps the energy high.
music.summary: A raucous karaoke party with a 1000+ song catalog spanning every genre, featuring solo, duet and group sing‑alongs on big screens and a lively late‑night crowd, plus an upstairs “Next Level” lounge that streams the stage.

music.name: Every Thursday: “Inner Circle” Dance Party at White Rabbit (SF)
music.why: Long-running, DJ-focused residency with a rotating lineup that keeps each night fresh.
music.summary: A weekly Thursday dance party where rotating guest DJs spin house, disco, remixes, current tracks and classics, focusing on DJ-curated sets and a dancefloor-first vibe. The long-running weekly brings a communal, groove-oriented atmosphere for people who want to move or just vibe to energetic, eclectic mixes.

music.name: The Polish Ambassador
music.address: 628 Divisadero Street, San Francisco, CA, United States
music.why: A dance-focused EDM/live crossover set that mixes live performance energy with purpose-driven visuals and production.
music.summary: The Polish Ambassador delivers an inventive, genre-blending live-electronic set — equal parts beatsmith, producer and dance-floor general — built from funky, melodic productions, playful sound design and high-energy, cinematic textures. Founder of Jumpsuit Records, his performances pair crowd-ready EDM elements with live-show dynamics and an eco-minded, purpose-driven spirit.

music.name: Victoria Monét
music.why: Arena‑scale presentation of her JAGUAR II‑era, mainstream breakthrough material.
music.summary: Victoria Monét performs polished, genre‑blending R&B and pop drawn from her acclaimed JAGUAR II era, including the culture‑defining hit 'On My Mama', showcasing lush songwriting and confident stagecraft.

music.name: $1 Drink Fridays: “Battle of the Decades” DJ Party (North Beach)
music.why: The hour-by-hour “Battle of the Decades” format swaps eras (and drink deals) every hour.
music.summary: A weekly DJ party where a live DJ spins decade-themed sets — each hour spotlights a different decade — spread across two rooms and an outdoor patio, with the music paired to a progressing happy-hour drink menu.

music.name: 3BallMTY
music.why: A full-club set from a Latin-electronic act.
music.summary: 3BallMTY delivers a high-energy Latin-electronic set built for the dancefloor, blending driving electronic production with club-focused Latin rhythms.

music.name: Afterlife
music.why: A well-priced club night at one of SF's longest-running dance venues, with doors at $10–$15.
music.summary: Afterlife is a late-night electronic dance party at DNA Lounge, running from 9:30 PM to 2 AM on Friday, December 18.

music.name: Blow The Whistle
music.why: A proper warehouse-style dance night at one of SF's best-sounding clubs, with a full four hours on the floor.
music.summary: Blow The Whistle takes over The Midway in Bayview for a late Friday night of club music, 10pm to 2am.

music.name: CASA TULUM - A Tulum Inspired House Music Party
music.address: 161 Erie Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
music.why: Long-form, Tulum-style melodic and Afrohouse programming that favors a patient late-night groove.
music.summary: A Tulum‑inspired house party at the Public Works Loft that leans into Afrohouse, melodic house and deeper, atmospheric sounds—built to grow slowly and keep the room moving for a long night of dancing rather than quick-hit drops.

music.name: Club CVNT: WOR$T RAVE IN AMERICA
music.why: An album-release rave built around hyperpop energy and surprise drag moments.
music.summary: A queer, drag-forward rave celebrating Slayyyter's new album with hyperpop and EDM — DJ sets from Tony OMFG, Beverly Chills and Frankie Peatt plus surprise drag performances.

music.name: Cristoph, Almas b2b Pathfynder
music.address: 316 11th St; San Francisco CA 94103; United States
music.why: Features a back-to-back support set pairing two DJs.
music.summary: Cristoph returns with support from ALMAS b2b PATHFYNDER, presented as a back-to-back DJ support set.

music.name: Death Angel
music.why: A hometown holiday ritual for Bay Area metal fans: loud, sweaty and a long-running Christmas tradition.
music.summary: Bay Area thrash legends Death Angel return to The Fillmore for the 11th annual "Another Death Angel Xmas Show," with Haunt and The Hunt in support.

music.name: “Elf” Live in Concert with SF Symphony (Dec. 18-20)
music.address: 201 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94102
music.why: A live-to-film presentation with the composer conducting the score alongside the on-screen picture.
music.summary: The San Francisco Symphony performs John Debney’s score live to a high-definition screening of the holiday film, with Debney conducting the orchestra in sync with the movie.

music.name: GENESI
music.address: 1015 Folsom Street; San Francisco, CA 94103; United States
music.why: A Beatport-topping, heavily streamed producer known for crossover melodic-house/techno sets.
music.summary: GENESI is an Italian producer who blends underground house, melodic elements and techno into an eclectic, crossover-friendly club sound, crafting melodic-house and techno sets that marry soaring melodies with dancefloor grooves.

music.name: Locky, Taking Back Sundance, Midtwn
music.why: A rare U.S. debut from a rising UK underground-house talent.
music.summary: LOCKY, a London artist known for bridging raw underground credibility and mainstream appeal, makes his US debut with a set of chunky minimal rhythms, tech‑house basslines and forward‑thinking electronic grooves, supported by Taking Back Sundance and Midtwn.

music.name: Michael Leathers
music.why: An immersive NEUROTECHNO worldbuilding set that turns a DJ slot into a cinematic, dystopian rave transmission.
music.summary: A NEUROTECHNO set of acid-driven techno and industrial-tinged electronic music, blending EBM and warehouse rave energy with cyberpunk, cinematic textures into hypnotic, peak-time club grooves.

music.name: Milk & Bone, PRXZM
music.why: Intimate club show for lush, synth-driven electro-pop in one of SF's coziest rooms.
music.summary: Canadian dream-pop duo Milk & Bone play Rickshaw Stop with PRXZM in support.

music.name: Namito
music.why: A cross-cultural blend of Tehran-inflected melodies and Berlin-honed deep/Afro house.
music.summary: Namito brings a dancefloor-focused DJ set of deep house and Afro house threaded with Persian melodies, drawing on his Berlin club background and Tehran-rooted records for a melodic, club-facing vibe.

music.name: NO BIAS: Oak City Slums b2b Bored Lord
music.why: A back-to-back between Oakland producer-DJs on a label night known for bass-heavy club sets.
music.summary: NO BIAS, the Bay Area label and nightlife series, takes over Tamarack in Oakland with Oak City Slums b2b Bored Lord, 10pm to 2am.

music.name: NYX - LATE NIGHT CLUBBING #102 (FRIDAY) w/: Surprise Guest
music.why: Day-of address and a strict no-photos policy create an intimate, clandestine club vibe.
music.summary: An invite-only late-night clubbing party billed with a “Surprise Guest” and NYX's club selectors; RSVP is required and the event address is sent the day of. The night is presented as a photography-free experience — no photos or videos allowed.

music.name: Petey Usa
music.why: Viral-era songs expanded into cinematic, full-band indie-rock arrangements.
music.summary: An emotionally honest, hook-driven indie-rock set that blends sharp storytelling and cinematic production with vivid, conversational lyrics. The songs turn everyday humor, heartbreak, anxiety and optimism into cathartic, anthemic moments.

music.name: PROX. DJ CZ, Shaper, Héloïse, Bjørne, Peter Clarke, 480P
music.address: 424 Haight St, San Francisco, CA 94117, United States
music.why: Blends machine‑learning–driven live performance with hybrid dub and acid techno sets.
music.summary: A mixed electronic bill combining DJs and live projects: DJ CZ (Chris Zaldua) draws on liminal, interstitial selections from his Stratus/Vague Terrain/Left Hand Path work while Shaper delivers a hybrid dub‑and‑psychedelia set linked to Metalheadz. Héloïse performs immersive live techno that uses machine‑learning to turn voice and movement into instruments, and Bjørn offers an acid‑tinged live techno set on TR‑1000.

music.name: Ravers Of Harmony: Paradox X Coven, Moxbpm, Ident, Mandi Darkling, Catophony, Yuba, DJm4lice, Midnight Empire
music.why: A playful, theatrical late-night rave with a costume discount that encourages immersive, performative energy.

music.name: SABO x 20 Yrs of Sol Selectas, 360 Experience x Open 2 Close By SET & Safra
music.why: An open-to-close, multi-hour celebration marking two decades of the Sol Selectas imprint.
music.summary: SABO plays an open-to-close six-hour set celebrating 20 years of his Sol Selectas label, blending deep house, tropical bass, dub, disco and reggae into a moombahton-rooted, festival-ready DJ journey.

music.name: Two Gallants
music.why: A hometown duo on a small-club stage for a good cause. Check for returns before you go, since the listing says sold out.
music.summary: Two Gallants, the San Francisco rock, blues and folk duo, play a benefit show for the Community Music Center's Young Musicians Program at Bottom of the Hill, with The Wind-Ups opening. Listed as sold out.

music.name: Venna
music.why: Hear the sax-led originals and production of a Grammy-recognized collaborator.
music.summary: Venna is a multi-instrumentalist and producer whose music blends saxophone-driven R&B, afrobeats and contemporary pop; he performs material from his debut project Venology and showcases the soulful sax lines and production that have powered collaborations with major international artists.

music.name: Wor$T Rave In America: Beverly Chills, Tony Omfg, Frankie Peatt, Oshe
music.why: An album-release queer rave that fuses hyperpop and EDM with drag-led performances and immersive visuals.
music.summary: Club CVNT stages a queer, drag-forward rave celebrating Slayyyter's WOR$T MAN IN AMERICA with DJ sets from Beverly Chills, Tony OMFG, Frankie Peatt and Oshe, plus immersive visuals and surprise drag performances.

music.name: 40 Orbits: Turquoise Drive, 93FM, Garrison
music.address: 101 6th Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
music.why: Features Sacramento visitors from the Call & Response collective delivering rare, groove-forward underground sets.
music.summary: A community-focused dance night centered on underground tunes: Turquoise Drive delivers deep, groove-driven, left-field house and techno built around hypnotic rhythms and a steady pulse. 93FM and Garrison (from Sacramento’s Call & Response) bring warm, genre-fluid sets that sit between subtle funk and late-night introspection, with Ray.One.Way opening with deep blends, rolling grooves and minimal house textures.

music.name: Adam Shulman Trio Plays a Charlie Brown Christmas
music.why: A jazz trio interpretation of the beloved Guaraldi soundtrack.
music.summary: Pianist Adam Shulman and his trio deliver a cozy holiday tribute to Vince Guaraldi’s A Charlie Brown Christmas, playing Guaraldi originals such as "Christmas Time Is Here," "Skating," and the iconic "Linus and Lucy," alongside classic holiday songs arranged for jazz trio.

music.name: Allman Betts Family Revival
music.why: A rare all-star Southern rock and blues jam in one of the best rooms in the city, on the last stretch of the tour.
music.summary: Devon Allman and Duane Betts bring the 10th-anniversary Family Revival tour to The Fillmore, with the Allman Betts Band and a rotating cast of guests including Robert Randolph, Judith Hill and Luther Dickinson.

music.name: Avenues Crew, Groover Thompson, Luke T, Cbird
music.address: 424 Haight St, San Francisco, CA 94117, United States
music.why: Centered on a ‘Greasyy Beats’ vibe that blends house, techno and minimal styles.
music.summary: Avenues Crew and the Dark Dayz family present a warm, welcoming night of “Greasyy Beats,” mixing house, techno, minimal, electro and deep dancefloor sounds.

music.name: Circuit Papi - Isis Muretech
music.why: A live DJ/producer set from Mexico brings international circuit-party energy.
music.summary: Presented by Club Papi, Circuit Papi SF features DJ/producer Isis Muretech (Mexico) performing live in a high-energy circuit-party format.

music.name: David Archuleta
music.why: An intimate, big-voiced pop night in a historic Castro movie palace.
music.summary: David Archuleta plays his holiday-season tour stop at the Castro Theatre; doors 7 PM, show 8 PM.

music.name: “Elf” Live in Concert with SF Symphony (Dec. 18-20)
music.address: 201 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94102
music.why: The film’s composer, John Debney, conducts the score live to picture.
music.summary: A high-definition screening of the film with the San Francisco Symphony performing John Debney’s score live, conducted by the composer and synced to the picture for a cinematic, orchestral holiday experience.

music.name: The Emo Night Tour
music.why: The immersive scream‑along format pairs a DJ with a live cover band to turn the room into a cathartic, crowd-led singalong.
music.summary: A traveling “scream‑along” party centered on early‑2000s pop‑punk and post‑hardcore, where a DJ and a guest cover band lead the crowd through all‑night singalongs of emo favorites. Expect high‑energy, nostalgic singalongs and moshing to genre staples and deep cuts.

music.name: Frozen: Joseph James, Kaeno, Sequence Six, Derek Ryan, Duvala, Blurr, Triceradrops, Brenden Bartels, Dirty n Divine, Alastair James
music.why: Two-room bill pairing established names with next‑generation and international talent.
music.summary: Synked presents FROZEN: a two-room trance and techno showcase with a Main Room featuring Joseph James, Kaeno, Sequence Six, Derek Ryan, Duvala and Blurr and a Dazzle Room hosting Triceradrops, Brenden Bartels, Dirty n Divine and Alastair James. The night is about reconnecting the Bay Area's trance & techno community while opening doors to regional, continental and international talent.

music.name: Giolì & Assia
music.address: 316 11th St; San Francisco CA 94103; United States
music.why: A limited-capacity, intimate club set that’s expected to sell out.
music.summary: Giolì & Assia perform an intimate headline set with support from Empress.

music.name: Hedex presents Nu Era
music.why: A dedicated jump‑up DnB takeover that focuses on high-energy, club-ready sets.
music.summary: Hedex drops jump‑up drum and bass in a Bassrush takeover, delivering high-energy, dancefloor-focused sets.

music.name: Late Night Clubbing #102
music.why: A members-only, phone-free late night for people who want a proper after-hours dance floor in SF.
music.summary: NYX's secret-location after-hours club night, with a surprise guest. RSVP to get the address by SMS on the day. No photos or video allowed.

music.name: Moulton Music Holiday Party: Give Back to the Groove
music.address: 161 Erie Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
music.why: Proceeds support Music Connects Foundation’s music education programs.
music.summary: Moulton Music’s holiday party brings a special DJ lineup — Harlum Muziq (David Harness & Chris Lum) with Homero Espinosa b2b John Glass — for a dancefloor-focused, community-minded night. The event is a fundraiser benefiting Music Connects Foundation to support music education and opportunities through music.

music.name: NYX - LATE NIGHT CLUBBING #103 (SATURDAY) w/: Surprise Guest
music.why: Day-of address and a strict no-photos policy create an intimate, clandestine after-hours vibe.
music.summary: An invite-only late-night clubbing party billed with a “Surprise Guest” and NYX's club selectors; RSVP is required and the event address is sent the day of. House and EDM until the early hours.

music.name: program audio: tba
music.why: A SoMa club night from a promoter that holds NOTAFLOF tickets for people who can't afford entry.
music.summary: Program Audio's late-night club event at F8 on Folsom, 10pm to 4am, with the lineup still to be announced.

music.name: PURA Saturdays
music.why: Four-room, multi-level party focused on Latin and open-format dance floors.
music.summary: A multi-room Saturday dance party blending reggaeton, Latin urbano, salsa, bachata, open-format and EDM, with DJs spinning hip-hop and fresh mixes across separate rooms for nonstop, high-energy dancing. The night showcases a rotating DJ team delivering current Latin club hits alongside classic dancefloor favorites.

music.name: Shaun Cassidy
music.why: A pop-idol-era songwriter mixing hits, stories and seasonal songs in an intimate North Beach theater.
music.summary: Shaun Cassidy brings his holiday show, Unwrapped: Songs & Stories for the Holidays, to Bimbo's 365 Club.

music.name: Sorley, Jordy, Xander Hayden
music.why: A fast-rising British producer serving a modern take on classic house.
music.summary: Sorley — the fast-rising British producer — brings classic house energy with a modern twist, delivering heavy basslines, raw grooves and an infectious underground vibe. He hits the decks with support from Jordy and Xander Hayden.

music.name: Supertask & Goopsteppa presented by Public Works & Bicycle Day
music.address: 161 Erie Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
music.why: A mix of code-driven audiovisual immersion paired with lush, journey-style bass sets.
music.summary: Supertask and Goopsteppa deliver an immersive, bass-forward electronic night — Supertask blends hip‑hop roots with analog and digital sound design and code‑informed production to create sentient, mind‑bending soundscapes and visuals, while Goopsteppa crafts lush, genre‑blurring bass journeys through dreamy textures.

music.name: Takuya Nakamura
music.address: 1290 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA 94109, USA
music.why: A stop on the Shape The Future North America tour.
music.summary: Part of the Shape The Future North America tour, the bill features Takuya Nakamura with support from RP Boo.

music.name: Wicked  - 35 Years of Free Form Funk: Tom Of England, Jenö, Tranquil Elephantizer
music.why: A 35-year anniversary marked by a fresh vinyl release and rare guest DJ/live hybrid performances.
music.summary: A celebration of a pioneering Bay Area dance crew’s 35 years, revisiting their Full Moon parties, late-night acid house jams, bus tours and trademark purple Turbo sound system while bringing their DIY ethos to the dancefloor. The night marks the vinyl release of WKD014 — a collaboration between Tony Humphries, Tranquil Elephantizer and the crew — with Thomas flying in to join Markie and Jenö on the decks and Tranquil Elephantizer performing a unique hybrid set.

music.name: 35th Annual Candlelight Christmas Concert (Mission Dolores Basilica)
music.why: Features three traditional Latin hymns, a mix of historic international carols, and a communal sing‑along.
music.summary: Conductor Jerome Lenk leads the choir and a chamber orchestra through a program that begins with three traditional Latin hymns and moves through centuries‑old and international Christmas carols, with opportunities for the audience to join in singing popular carols.

music.name: Allman Betts Family Revival
music.why: A ten-year family-curated tradition that assembles high-profile guest musicians to reinterpret deep cuts from a classic Southern-rock songbook.
music.summary: A decade-old, family-led revival that gathers a rotating, star-studded ensemble to perform deep cuts from the Allman Brothers catalog, reworking those Southern-rock classics in an energetic, collaborative, Last Waltz–style format.

music.name: Alyssa Edwards – A Very Alyssa Christmas
music.why: Camp, sequins and Dallas-sized sass for the season, in SF's most iconic LGBTQ theater.
music.summary: Drag Race icon Alyssa Edwards brings her holiday show A Very Alyssa Christmas to the Castro Theatre. 18+.

music.name: “Elf” Live in Concert with SF Symphony (Dec. 18-20)
music.address: 201 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94102
music.why: The film’s orchestral score is performed live in sync with the screening.
music.summary: The San Francisco Symphony performs John Debney’s score live to the film Elf, with the composer conducting as the movie plays in high-definition on the big screen.

music.name: Holiday Party w/ Monkey Safari, Marcello Dellaccio, Dim the Sky
music.summary: A festive rooftop holiday party presented by Safra & Konnekted, featuring the “incredibly talented” Monkey Safari alongside Marcello Dellaccio and Dim the Sky. The bill promises a celebratory, dancefloor-forward holiday vibe.

music.name: Holiday Party with Monkey Safari at Via Hotel Rooftop
music.why: Funktion One sound on a covered, heated rooftop for daytime dancing.
music.summary: A daytime rooftop holiday party that brings together crews Prismatic, Mioli and Airpusher with sets from Monkey Safari and several local DJs, spinning upbeat, dancefloor-focused electronic music. The rooftop is covered and heated with Funktion One sound and 360-degree city views for warm daytime vibes.

music.name: Just Friends, Carpool Tunnel, Bones Shredder
music.why: Part of the original owners' weeklong farewell after 35 years — their final bow celebrating the venue's history.
music.summary: A celebratory evening featuring Just Friends, Carpool Tunnel, and Bones Shredder, presented as part of the original owners' weeklong farewell to honor the bands, fans, and community that built the club.

music.name: “Lindy in the Park” Swing Dance Party (Golden Gate Park)

sports.name: Lake to Ocean: A Nature Walk
sports.venue: Lake Merced Trail, 700 John Muir Drive
sports.address: 700 John Muir Drive, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Stunning coastal panoramas with frequent marine-life and hang-glider sightings.
sports.summary: A casual, just-under-2-mile group walk from Lake Merced Trail up to Fort Funston’s observation deck, with stops to chat and take in sweeping views of the ocean, coastline and city while watching for dolphins, whales and hang gliders.

sports.name: SF Underwater Hockey Beginners Game
sports.venue: Martin Luther King Pool, 5701 3rd St (At Carroll Ave, near Candlestick Park)
sports.address: 5701 3rd St (At Carroll Ave, near Candlestick Park), San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Coached, beginner-friendly session with equipment available.
sports.summary: Trained coaches run a coed, all-ages beginner session teaching underwater puck handling, teamwork and basic snorkel-based play; gear and fins can be provided if needed.

sports.name: Flight Club: Adult Flight Night for Ages 18+ at “House of Air” Trampoline Park (SF)
sports.address: 926 Old Mason Street, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Adults-only hours let you use all the jump zones without kids around.
sports.summary: An 18+ takeover of the trampoline park that gives adults full access to 70+ trampolines and every jump zone (The Matrix, Dodgeball Colosseum, Training Ground and The Court), accompanied by upbeat music, lounge space, and beer, wine and snacks available for purchase.

sports.name: In The Shadow Of The Bridge
sports.venue: Warming Hut Park Store, 983 Marine Dr, San Francisco, CA 94129, USA
sports.address: 983 Marine Dr, San Francisco, CA 94129, USA, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Focuses on lesser-known Presidio approaches and a climb to Rob Hill.
sports.summary: A guided roam around the approaches to the Golden Gate Bridge and through little pockets of the Presidio that skips crossing the bridge itself. Expect climbs up to Rob Hill and plenty of dirt tracks with a few off‑road sections.

sports.name: San Francisco Midnight Mystery Ride (Every Third Saturday)
sports.why: A leader‑led mystery route with a strict No Rider Left Behind ethos.
sports.summary: A communal midnight bicycle ride that rolls to a secret, leader‑chosen destination; rides are about 5 miles, run NRLB (No Rider Left Behind), and welcome all levels of cyclist. Start locations are posted on the group's website/Facebook the day of the ride; participants commonly meet at a local bar before rolling and bring provisions to share at the destination.

sports.name: Saturday Session #1 Tennis MeetUp
sports.why: Emphasis on friendly, social play that still lets you get competitive practice.
sports.summary: A casual group hitting session that brings players together for fun yet competitive tennis and post-match socializing.

sports.name: Saturday Session #2 Tennis MeetUp
sports.why: Casual yet competitive mixed-level hitting that doubles as a social meet-up.
sports.summary: A casual Saturday tennis meetup for players to get some fun hitting in — a mix of friendly and competitive play where participants can meet and socialize.

sports.name: Squash in the Mission (Saturday)
sports.why: Free, drop-in community squash with a built-in post-game social.
sports.summary: A casual, active squash meetup where players drop in for pick-up games on the rec center courts even if they haven't signed up on Meetup; the group is social and often heads out for food together afterward.

sports.name: Weekly Walk for Deep Chats (The Board Walks)
sports.why: Combines a short, structured circle-sharing ritual with open, roaming small-group conversations during a long outdoor walk.
sports.summary: A guided 5-mile group walk for curious people who love deep conversations. Participants bring one thoughtful topic, gather for a brief circle to share a 60‑second introduction, then drift into 2–3 person conversations while they walk.

sports.name: Golden Gate Park Sunday Roller Disco Party (SF)
sports.address: 6th Ave. and Kennedy Drive, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Mobile DJ setup plus on-the-spot choreographed roller-dance lessons make it a participatory skate party.
sports.summary: A weekly outdoor roller-disco session where a mobile DJ unit spins groovy, funky tunes for inline and roller skaters, and attendees often teach and learn choreographed roller-disco dance moves.

sports.name: 💚Green Exercise Easy 5 Miles 🥾Hike SF Golden Gate Park🏞️
sports.venue: Great Highway & John F Kennedy Drive
sports.why: A wellness-first, social hike designed to boost mental and physical health while connecting participants.
sports.summary: A community wellness walk through Golden Gate Park — an easy-to-moderate 5+ mile loop (about 500 ft elevation) focused on physical and mental wellbeing and meeting new people; bring water, snacks, layers and sturdy shoes.

sports.name: Invisalign Bay Area Women's Classic: Cal vs. Nebraska & Stanford vs. Ohio State
sports.why: Four big-name programs and a free hat for the first 5,000 fans make this an easy Sunday-afternoon outing in Mission Bay.
sports.summary: Women's college basketball doubleheader at Chase Center: Cal vs. Nebraska and Stanford vs. Ohio State. Doors open 2 PM; the first 5,000 fans get a hat.
